mapper.select: WITH picked AS(SELECT id FROM pf.workspace_environment_outbox WHERE status='PENDING' OR(status='PUBLISHING' AND relay_until<clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY created_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 10) UPDATE pf.workspace_environment_outbox o SET status='PUBLISHING',relay_owner=#{owner},relay_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '10 seconds' FROM picked WHERE o.id=picked.id RETURNING o.id,o.operation_id,o.space_id,o.workspace_id,o.environment_id,o.generation,o.fence,o.relay_owner
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.workspace_environment_outbox SET status='PUBLISHED''PENDING',relay_owner=NULL,relay_until=NULL WHERE id=#{item.id} AND relay_owner=#{item.relayOwner} AND generation=#{item.generation} AND fence=#{item.fence} AND status='PUBLISHING' AND relay_until>clock_timestamp()
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_environment_outbox WHERE id=#{item.id} AND operation_id=#{item.operationId} AND space_id=#{item.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{item.workspaceId} AND environment_id=#{item.environmentId} AND generation=#{item.generation} AND fence=#{item.fence})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.workspace_environment_inbox(event_id,operation_id) VALUES(#{eventId},#{operationId}) ON CONFLICT(event_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT 'ENVIRONMENT_V2' AS protocol,o.kind,o.initiator,o.command_id,o.id AS operation_id,o.space_id,o.workspace_id,o.environment_id, o.actor_id,o.owner_id,o.generation,o.fence,e.creation_command_id,e.creation_fence,e.image_id,e.policy_hash,w.project_id, CASE WHEN o.kind='STOP' THEN e.container_id ELSE NULL END AS container_id, CASE WHEN o.kind='STOP' THEN e.container_started_at ELSE NULL END AS container_started_at,o.deadline_at AS deadline FROM pf.workspace_environment_operation o JOIN pf.workspace_environment e ON e.id=o.environment_id JOIN pf.workspace w ON w.id=o.workspace_id WHERE o.id=#{operationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.workspace_environment_operation SET status='CLAIMED',owner_id=#{owner},lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '60 seconds',deadline_at=clock_timestamp()+interval '120 seconds',version=version+1 WHERE id=#{operationId} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.sql: id=#{command.operationId} AND command_id=#{command.commandId} AND space_id=#{command.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{command.workspaceId} AND environment_id=#{command.environmentId} AND owner_id=#{command.ownerId} AND generation=#{command.generation} AND fence=#{command.fence} AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND deadline_at>clock_timestamp()
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_environment_operation WHERE AND status IN('CLAIMED','RUNNING'))
SELECT request_hash FROM pf.workspace_environment_command WHERE command_id=#{commandId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.workspace_runner_instance(id,container_id,image_id,started_at) VALUES(#{runner.id},#{runner.containerId},#{runner.imageId},#{runner.startedAt}) ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id,container_id,image_id,started_at FROM pf.workspace_runner_instance WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_runner_instance i WHERE i.id=#{id} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_runner_stop_proof p WHERE p.runner_instance_id=i.id))
SELECT runner_instance_id FROM pf.workspace_environment_command WHERE command_id=#{commandId}

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_environment_command c WHERE c.command_id=#{commandId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_runner_instance i WHERE i.id=#{runnerId} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_runner_stop_proof p WHERE p.runner_instance_id=i.id)) AND(c.runner_instance_id=#{runnerId} OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_runner_stop_proof p WHERE p.runner_instance_id=c.runner_instance_id)))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.workspace_environment_command(command_id,space_id,workspace_id,environment_id,operation_id,generation,fence,owner_id,runner_instance_id,request_hash,state) VALUES(#{command.commandId},#{command.spaceId},#{command.workspaceId},#{command.environmentId},#{command.operationId},#{command.generation},#{command.fence},#{command.ownerId},#{runnerId},#{hash},'RUNNING') ON CONFLICT(command_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT result_text AS result_json,content_hash FROM pf.workspace_environment_receipt WHERE command_id=#{commandId} ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.workspace_environment_command SET state=#{receipt.state},result_revision=#{receipt.revision},result_runner_instance_id=#{runnerId} WHERE command_id=#{command.commandId} AND operation_id=#{command.operationId} AND owner_id=#{command.ownerId} AND generation=#{command.generation} AND fence=#{command.fence} AND state='RUNNING' AND result_revision=0
UPDATE pf.workspace SET environment_state=#{state},version=version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE space_id=#{command.spaceId} AND id=#{command.workspaceId}

UPDATE pf.workspace_sandbox_slot SET space_id=NULL,workspace_id=NULL,environment_id=NULL,generation=NULL,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1 AND space_id=#{command.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{command.workspaceId} AND environment_id=#{command.environmentId} AND generation=#{command.generation}

UPDATE pf.workspace_environment_operation SET status='FAILED',effect_state='NOT_STARTED',error_code='ENVIRONMENT_AUTHORIZATION_REVOKED',version=version+1 WHERE id=#{operationId} AND kind='PREPARE' AND status='PENDING' AND effect_state='NOT_STARTED'
